scripts.dev: npm run build -w @traceapi/timeline && npm run dev -w trace-nextjs-starter
scripts.build: npm run build -w @traceapi/timeline && npm run build -w trace-nextjs-starter
scripts.test: npm run build -w @traceapi/timeline && node --test packages/timeline/test/*.test.mjs tools/test/*.test.mjs templates/templates.test.mjs && npm run test -w trace-nextjs-starter
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @traceapi/timeline && npm run typecheck -w trace-nextjs-starter
